title: Steady
creator: geniusendy / Devendurance
summary: November 22, 2026: The Payroll contract locks an aggregate budget and lets the employer release it; it does not enforce individual employee payments. Separate stealth payouts are outside that contract. Monthly total, headcount and roster hash are public, so small-team inference remains possible. Employer and claim interfaces are simulations; the proof page reads indexer metadata. The creator supplies a funded-vault and release history, but those submitted transaction IDs were not known to the queried indexer today. Both official catalogues independently confirm the deployed Payroll template. Review used original submission text, README, license metadata and extracted public-page text. Creator test results were not rerun. This recording is a continuous README walkthrough with page scripts and downloads disabled; no wallet, funds or third-party code was operated.
cardSummary: Explore aggregate payroll funding and release records alongside simulated employer and employee views and a public proof page.
